Cyber City Oedo 808 - Kemono no Alignmen.summary: The anime series comes to PC Engine as a cyberpunk adventure.

Magical Dinosaur Tour.name: Magical Dinosaur Tour
Magical Dinosaur Tour.summary: You're exploring a primeval forest over 100 million years ago. Suddenly, the mighty Tyrannosaurus appears! With a push of a button, you bring him to life! The magic of TurboGrafx-CD brings the exciting world of dinosaurs into your home. Move through 20 prehistoric panoramas and watch creatures spring into action as they search for food and struggle for survival. Sort through hundreds of the mighty beasts and see what may have led to their ultimate extinction.

Mahjong Sword - Princess Quest Gaiden.name: Mahjong Sword: Princess Quest Gaiden
Mahjong Sword - Princess Quest Gaiden.summary:
Mahjong Sword: Princess Quest Gaiden is a Mahjong video game developed and published by Naxat Soft for the TurboGrafx-16/PC Engine System in 1995.

It is a censored port of the PC-98 game, "Mahjong Sword: Princess Quest" which was released a few months prior and the game is an off-shoot to the quirky PC-98 Board / Card RPG, "KuruKuru Party: Princess Quest"
